rita: flagging oddities on cost dashboard: several 5-token calls billed as 50 tokens.

mike: saw same on staging. likely cache miss + prefetch double-count.

sandeep: any invocation id to sample?

rita: inv-2025-02-11-cc1. console snippet: tokens=5, billed=50, model=redwood-3b-q4

ops-bot: sample for inv-2025-02-11-cc1 -> cache_namespace: ns_alpha, router_reads: ns_alpha_v2, prefetch_attempts:1, success:0

mike: namespace drift. we never show cache namespace in UI. propose a tiny "cost debug" pill that surfaces cache_namespace and prefetch outcome for sampled traces. default off.

sandeep: agree. keep payload minimal and sampled (0.1% default), tenant override capped at 1%. add audit when someone views debug.

rita: I'll open RFC for feature flag and minimal schema. ops-bot: create runbook todo to run reconciliation query across billing.invocations vs telemetry.cache_events for last 7d.

ops-bot: done. created ticket: PLAT-8942.
